title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: Master FOB Audience Cassette > Nak CM300 mics > Sony D5: master cassetteplayed back via a Nakamichi DR-1 > HHB 850 > EAC for DAE to Harddrive >CEP > CDWave > CDRWin > Yamaha CR8424 CDR

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 Portland show captured on a lively audience FOB, with a smoking second set and solid sound quality.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience FOB that puts the crowd front‑and‑center, delivering clear, crisp sound with only minor occasional drop‑outs. The performance shines especially in the second set – Touch of Grey, Estimated Prophet/Eyes of the World, Spanish jam, The Other One, Morning Dew, Sugar Magnolia and High Time are repeatedly praised as exceptional, and Jerry’s guitar work is described as “on fire.” Overall the show radiates a high‑octane vibe that many reviewers rank among the best of the early ’80s.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen reviews, most 4–5 stars, highlight an outstanding second set and generally good audience recording quality; only a few minor criticisms keep the rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑center crowd ambience, crisp and clean overall; occasional comment about sound not being “par with show,” but most find it very listenable. No mic for Brent’s piano during the show.

standout_songs: Estimated Prophet > Eyes of the World
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid, second set tight and seamless with superb transitions; the encore (U.S. Blues) is divisive but still appreciated by many.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “on fire,” perfect tone, never bails, rocks throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Very active with “thunder” in his space bomb; crowd chants for him during the jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s 1982 country‑western piano sound noted; no mic set up for him during the performance.
